# Separate immutable geometry from live economic observation

Implement one C++ observation-representation change inside the complete leader-informed economic strategy. This is not another strategy policy or a request to rebuild unrelated modules. Base commit: `183abac732118fca75a01833a91d9b54f59ba6ea`; base bot: `local_economic_batches_01`; candidate: `pi_economic-topology-01`. The bridge copies that exact bot. Leave changes uncommitted for the bridge.

## Why this change

The complete strategy already replaces economic task selection and execution together: role-aware earning/capture/delivery cycles, retained routes, shared action ledger, service abilities and banking. It is still stationary in actual release games, so there is no stronger-bot claim. The parent passes its focused97-assertion batching fixture and full native checks, but both SwirlA and VaultA against frozen C02 fail opening activity. No online uploads or strength panels belong to this task.

Root's two buffered diagnostic games on this exact source show all4 Swirl actors crossing epochs while building group records, no capture returns/planner entries. Warm actor0 round5: capture starts98839fuel; before member construction72068; before visible member reads54597(106descriptors/14visible); after visible reads40773; after hidden siblings29741; after champions/before groups22193; after groups round6. Do not subtract across rounds. Vault all4return captures with22634..24367fuel, below30000field admission; every planner delivery return deferred, no native field compute. Actor0 round5 group block18196fuel and final locks/threat/cache/return13480fuel. These broad blocks include scalar construction, copying, allocation, SDK work and probe overhead; they are not isolated copy benchmarks.

Source inspection: capture reconstructs every Group's immutable metadata/spawn vector each time, initializes every Member twice, then deep-copies the entire Scene into `previous`. Patch consumers use only previous self/visible/occupied/members/allies/enemies, never previous groups/altars/abilities/locks. Public cached map-group member/spawn/reward accessors are immutable. World::init builds and sorts camps once; World::refresh updates dynamic fields but not identities/member metadata.

Three designs were compared. Prebuilding/reserving owned vectors is low integration cost but retains recurring deep copies. Immutable shared owned geometry with fresh dynamic observations and compact history addresses the repeated work while retaining all observed facts. Phased/targeted reads could save imports but require a much larger knowledge-state/consumer redesign. **Implement the second design.** Do not substitute the first alone or silently adopt sparse reads.

## Interface and implementation

Keep the public capture seam `EconomicCapture::capture(World&,LiveTurn&,int) -> economic::Scene`. Keep Scene's ordinary owned dynamic records and existing physical/safety methods. Replace recurring per-scene group metadata allocation with an owned immutable geometry object shared by complete returned and frozen scenes. Use a straightforward `std::shared_ptr<const Geometry>` (or equivalently clear owned immutable lifetime), not borrowed pointers/spans whose World/capture owner can disappear. Geometry holds bounded per-group anchor/rewards/spawn contacts in the same group order. Keep altitude/altar/width representation unchanged unless needed for this specific change; no unnecessary consumer rewrite.

It is appropriate to separate `GroupGeometry` from `Group`'s dynamic `GroupObservation`. Adapt `economic_candidates.cpp` to read its existing metadata from Scene's geometry, preserving the exact enumeration order, work estimates, recipients, utility, contact tie breaks and choices. Validate missing geometry/group-size mismatch before dereference. Service/owner/planner lifecycle reads must continue to use fresh dynamic group observations. Native service-only fixtures may have no geometry when they do not rank; do not make every unrelated fixture manufacture it.

Build geometry only once from validated public metadata, in private scratch. No externally mutable aliases may change it after publication. Cold initialization errors/stale reads must not publish partial topology or dynamic facts. Private resumable immutable construction is acceptable only if genuinely needed, explicitly identity-bound and bounded; do not create a second dynamic observation cache or adopt a later epoch inside a capture. Retain128groups/256members/16384cells and all current rejection behavior. Scene copies must share immutable geometry; later captures cannot mutate old or planner-frozen scenes. An escaped Scene must retain metadata after World/EconomicCapture destruction.

Replace `economic::Scene previous` in EconomicCapture with the smallest owned receipt history actually read by the existing patch proof: self facts, visible/occupied masks, members and ally/enemy scalar rows. Rewire the existing proof to those fields; do not weaken any predicate or change which HP can carry across an accepted stationary reset/shield/basic. Avoid copying unrelated group topology/dynamics/altar/ability/lock data into history. Preserve before/after scene independence and all receipt epoch/event attribution.

Avoid redundant default-initialization followed by overwrite when building fresh member rows; use one bounded owned construction of the same values. Reserve known bounded output sizes to prevent repeated growth where appropriate. Preserve last-known-position behavior, all unknown flags, hp/state epochs and unchanged-event fields. Do not add a second full persistent Member template without accounting for its storage and justification. Any changed copy/move lifetime must preserve cache publication semantics on allocation/error/rollover.

Do not add instrumentation to production. Report structural work/storage changes; measured engine savings are PC work and remain unknown.

## Preserve these contracts

- No policy, draft, shopping, combat, ranking formula, pathfinding, route/storage cap, field admission30000 or reserve5000 changes. No SDK/tool/config changes, raw/private production SDK access, direct memory tricks or fuel/debug bypass.
- Preserve every current dynamic public observation and its current same-capture semantics, including distant visible HP, all harmful strength, hidden siblings, champions, lifecycle/capture/holder facts, masks, locks, post-action receipts and original full-capture epoch. No fixed radius/selected-only thinning; no default0 harmful strength for omitted reads.
- Preserve original ordinary LiveTurn reads/preflight/perform and the parent's bounded getter batching, counters, stale/error semantics. No new guards that renew an old dispatch or partial Scene publication.
- Current task is not the only consumer: historical failure reopening can inspect another task; winning banking can preempt work; unknown harmful group siblings can block wake even at distant last positions; AoE touches other groups; service exact arithmetic reads all known member HP/strength. All these facts remain represented.
- Dynamic lifecycle/cycle/last-position/history publishes only after coherent whole-capture validation. A geometry cache must not disguise a new respawn, change dynamic role facts or mint a receipt. Preserve expected hidden errors as unknown, unexpected errors and stale precedence.
- Keep all existing native assertions. Update candidate-fixture data factories only where the geometry representation requires it. No deleting/weaking tests, replacing their assertions or reducing cases/counts.

## Allowed files

Production: `src/economic_scene.h`, `src/economic_scene_sdk.h`, `src/economic_scene_sdk.cpp`, `src/economic_candidates.cpp`; one small new header for immutable geometry is allowed if it improves locality. Do not edit unrelated production files.

Tests: `tests/economic_candidates.cpp` (fixture metadata construction only, preserve main/assertions), `tests/economic_capture_sdk.cpp` (extend actual-SDK scenarios only, preserve existing cases/assertions), a new `tests/economic_capture_topology.cpp`. Keep inherited `tests/economic_capture_batches.cpp` unchanged unless it literally cannot compile after the private-history refactor; explain any such necessary mechanical edit. `IMPLEMENTATION.md` is required. No other files.

## Focused verification and stopping point

Run focused C++ native checks available locally (no official compiler download or engine tournament). Do not spend the whole worker deadline on broad verification; implement, run the focused scenarios and return source promptly. The PC owns full native/API/release/game qualification.

Exercise the real capture seam and public SDK wrappers, using the existing scripted host: repeated captures share immutable geometry; a new dynamic lifecycle/member position/HP changes only the new scene; old/frozen scene metadata and observations stay unchanged; an escaped scene survives capture/World destruction; cold metadata error/rollover does not publish partial topology or dynamic lifecycle; successful later coherent capture has complete correct geometry. Include existing accepted basic/reset/shield patch behavior and actual guarded-error/epoch paths. Validate new geometry mismatch rejection in ranking without weakening the original78candidate checks. Do not claim engine activity, resource fit or strength from native results.

Write IMPLEMENTATION.md with actual changed files, ownership/publication reasoning, focused command/results (including failures), persistent storage changes and unverified gaps. End the task after coherent source plus focused checks/report. The unchanged PC sequence is source/semantic review, full native and batching/topology fixtures, two original uninstrumented release diagnostics, actual admission/storage assessment,12construction games,12direct games against the unchanged Bronze champion, then broader strength tests if qualified. No automatic80game screen, platform upload, ranked change or promotion.
